welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Ka jawaab dhowr su'aalood oo ku saabsan calaamadahaaga.

trustReviewed.translation: Dhakhtarka ayaa dib u eegis ku sameeyay

btnStart.translation: Bilow inaad ka hor tagto booqashada

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Tani waxay ku xiran tahay booqashadaada diiwaankaaga.

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Waad ku mahadsantihiin waxaan weydiin doonaa dhowr su'aalood oo degdeg ah oo ku saabsan waxa kuu keenay. goorma ayay bilowday?

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Ku qor jawaab, ama ku dhufo soo jeedinta kor ku xusan

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Guji shay kasta si aad u hagaajiso ka hor intaadan dirin.

btnSendToDoctor.translation: Waxay u muuqataa mid sax ah u dir dhakhtarka

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Haddii calaamadahaagu aad u daran yihiin ama ay sii xumaanayaan haatan, ha sugin wac adeegyada gargaarka degdegga ah.

urgencySeekCare.translation: Fadlan la xiriir daryeelka 12 saacadood gudahood

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Calaamadahaagu waxay muujinayaan in ay tahay in la arko dhawaan.

urgencyStep1Title.translation: Warbixintaada ayaa hadda la soo diray

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Kooxda caafimaadku waxay isla markiiba helayaan taariikhdaada la sameeyay.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Haddii ay sii xumaanayso dhaqso u dhaqso

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Dhibaatooyinka daran ama degdegga ah isla markiiba wac adeegyada gargaarka degdegga ah.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Tani waa qiyaas degdeg ah oo otomaatig ah, ma ahan cudur-daro, dhakhtarka ayaa go'aanka kama dambaysta ah qaata.

findHeroWelcome.translation: Soo dhawow dib u soo noqoshada

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: Mar horeba isbitaalkan ayaa laguugu arkay.

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Waxay horey u haystaan diiwaankaaga, sidaa darteed kooxda daryeelka ayaa isla markiiba arki doonta taariikhdaada oo dhan.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?
findSearchTitle.translation: Xagee baad jeclaan lahayd in lagaa arko?

findSearchSubtitle.en: Pick a Triavi hospital near you — your {level} brief is sent the moment you choose.
findSearchSubtitle.translation: Dooro isbitaal Triavi ah oo kuugu dhow warbixintaada {level} waxaa loo diraa daqiiqadda aad dooratid.

findScanning.translation: Raadinta isbitaalada Triavi ee kuugu dhow...

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Warbixintaadu waxay la socotaa kooxda daryeelka.

timelineReviewing.translation: Dhakhtarka ayaa dib u eegis ku sameynaya warbixintaada

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Haddii ay sii xumaanayso, dhaqso hadda

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Ha sugin booskaaga safka. Haddii calaamadahaagu aad u daran yihiin ama si lama filaan ah u sii darayaan wac adeegyada gargaarka degdegga ah hadda ama u tag qaybta ugu dhow ee xaaladaha degdegga ah.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Waxaan calaamadeynay kiiskaaga sida mudnaanta sare si kooxda daryeelka ay u ogaato.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Dhakhtar ayaa dib u eegis ku sameynaya warbixintaada.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Jawaab dhowr su'aalood oo ku saabsan sida aad u tahay tan iyo booqashadaada.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Xaaladdaadu sidee bay u egtahay marka la barbar dhigo sidii hore?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Ma jiraan wax kale oo aad rabto inaad noo sheegto?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Waan ku faraxsanahay inaad si fiican u dareento

checkinResultResolvedBody.en: We'll check in again {next} to make sure you're still improving.
checkinResultResolvedBody.translation: Waxaan dib u hubin doonnaa {next} si aan u hubino inaad wali hagaajineyso.

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today
checkinResultReview.translation: Dhakhaatiir ayaa maanta arintan fiirin doona.

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: Jawaabahaaga ayaa loo diray kooxda daryeelka, dhakhtarka ayaa dib u eegi doona oo la xiriiri doona haddii loo baahdo.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Calaamadahaagu waxay muujinayaan wax u baahan daryeel degdeg ah. Ha sugin la xiriir kooxda daryeelka ama tag qaybta ugu dhow ee xaaladaha degdegga ah.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Dib u eegista hadda lama heli karo. Isku qor si aad u aragto diiwaangelintaada hadda.

checkinExpiredSignIn.translation: Isku qor si aad u sii wadato

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Xisaab bilaash ah samee si aad u raadiso booqashadan oo marka xigta u dhaaf koodhka.

authVerifyTitle.translation: Aynu xaqiijino in ay tahay adiga

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Waxaan kuu soo diri doonnaa koodh hal mar ah oo aan lahayn lambarka sirta ah si aad u xasuusato.

authSecuredBy.translation: Waxaa damaanad qaaday Triavi · HIPAA waafaqsan

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.
otpSentTo.translation: Waxaa loo diray {dest}. Waxay ku dhammaaneysaa 10 daqiiqo.

signinWelcomeBack.translation: Soo dhawow dib u soo noqoshada

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Ku qor taleefankaaga ama emaylkaaga waxaanan kuu soo diri doonnaa lambarka diiwaangelinta.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Xisaabtaadu waxay ku xiran tahay diiwaanka isbitaalkaaga

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)
errInvalidPhone.translation: Ku qor lambarka taleefanka saxda ah (714 digits)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
errSendFailed.translation: Codka ma soo diri karin, mar kale isku day.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Khaladaadka shabakadda, hubi isku xirnaantaada oo isku day mar kale.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.
errCodeMismatch.translation: Koodhkaasi ma la mid ahayn, mar kale isku day.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Amnigaaga iyo ilaalinta xogta bukaanka, waxaa lagaa saxiixay ka dib wakhti aan waxqabad lahayn.

dashGreeting.translation: Soo dhawow dib u soo noqoshada

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Bilow diiwaangelinta si aad u bilowdo booqasho cusub.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Wicitaanada daryeelka ayaa ku dhacaya barnaamijkan · lambarkaaga taleefanka marnaba lama wadaago.

dashSimulateCall.translation: Isku day wicitaanada daryeelka soo galaya · demo

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Dooro cidda kuu soo wacaya, iyo sida ay u dhawaaqaan.

toneProfessionalDesc.translation: Si toos ah, si sax ah, oo aan la hadlin

toneUpbeat.translation: Waa mid cajiib ah oo rajo leh.

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Hello Jordan, waa waqtigii qiyaastaada fiidkii...

medReminderCallsDesc.translation: Daabacaadda qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta qiyaasta

postVisitCallsDesc.translation: "Sidee baad u dareemeysaa?" kadib markii la sii daayay

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Ma jiraan wicitaanada 9:30 pm 7:30 AM · dib ugu laabto ogeysiiska

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Lambarka daryeelkaagu wuxuu sii ahaadaa mid firfircoon dib ugu qor si aad u maamusho wicitaannada iyo xusuusinta.

callRingVerified.translation: Xaqiiji · iyada oo loo marayo khadka daryeelkaaga {code}

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: wicitaanada codka ah ee loo shaabadeeyay · WebRTC · lambarkaagu marnaba lama wadaago

callActiveEndConfirm.translation: Isku day in la joojiyo wicitaankan?

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Kaliya adiga iyo {hospital} ayaa arki kara waxyaalahan.

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Wali ma jirto wax daryeel ah oo loogu talagalay booqashadan.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Haddii calaamadahaagu soo noqdaan ama sii xumaanayaan, isla markiiba raadi daryeel degdeg ah.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Booqashadan waxaa laga yaabaa in la tirtiray, ama xiriirku ma shaqeynayo.

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Faahfaahinta faahfaahintaada, dhakhtarkaagu wuxuu arki doonaa wixii ugu dambeeyay.

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Isbedelka luqadda shaashad kasta isla markiiba.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Ma soo koobi karin - dooro oo gacanta ku soo koobi

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Waxa aan ilaalino, iyo waxa aad gacanta ku haysato.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Magacaaga, faahfaahinta xiriirkaada, iyo jawaabaha qoraalka bilaashka ah waa la tirtiraa ka hor inta aysan waxna ka bixin isbitaalkaaga. Kaliya kooxda daryeelka ayaa arki doonta faahfaahinta aqoonsiga; cilmi baarista iyo falanqaynta waxay arki doonaan macluumaadka aan aqoonsiga lahayn oo keliya.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: U oggolow macluumaadka aan la aqoonsanayn si loo hagaajiyo daryeelka qof walba. Waad beddeli kartaa wakhti kasta.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Xusuusinta ballanqaadka iyo xaqiijinta soo socota adoo wacaya ama riixaya. Waad beddeli kartaa wakhti kasta.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Si joogto ah u tirtir koontadaada iyo faahfaahinta xiriirka.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Codso nuqul ka mid ah warbixinnada booqashadaada, daawooyinkaada, iyo taariikhda daryeelka.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Tani waxay si joogto ah u tirtirtaa koontadaada iyo faahfaahinta xiriirkaaga. Isbitaalkaagu wuxuu hayaa taariikhda daryeelkaada sida sharciga u baahan yahay. Tani lama beddelin karo.

deleteSheetConfirmStepLabel.translation: Ku qor DELETE si aad u xaqiijiso

deleteRequestSubmitted.translation: Codsiga tirtirka oo la soo gudbiyay

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Kooxda daryeelkaagu waxay ku xaqiijin doontaa emayl 72 saacadood gudahood.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Dooro qaab iyo codso dhoofinta. Waxaan diyaarin doonaa oo waxaan u soo diri doonaa link aamin ah si aad email diiwaangashan.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: 24 saacadood gudahood waxaan kuu soo diri doonnaa xiriir ammaan ah cinwaankaaga diiwaangashan.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Wax fayl ah laguma soo dejisanayo halkan - diiwaankaaga si ammaan ah ayaa loo diraa emaylkaaga diiwaangashan.

ariaBackToInviteLink.translation: Dib ugu noqo si aad u casuumid link

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Ku dheji xiriirka martiqaadka ee isbitaalkaagu soo diray, ama ka baaraandeg lambarka QR-ga.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Taasi uma muuqato mid Triavi martiqaad link ama code.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Koodh caafimaad oo ansax ah ayaa si toos ah kuu geeya faahfaahintaada.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Koodh caafimaad oo ansax ah ayaa si toos ah kuu keenaya faahfaahintaada.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Sii ogolaanshaha kamaradda ee goobaha browser-kaaga, ama ku qor xiriirka casuumaadda gacanta.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Ma jiro kamarad la ogaaday, waxaad ku qortaa xiriirka martiqaadka ee isbitaalkaagu soo diray.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Sawirka kamaraddu hadda ma jiro, gacanta ku qor xiriirka casuumaadda.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
